messages:
Maya: Quick UX sync on rule rows and preview feedback signal. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-ruleflow-affordance. Question: should reorder be a small dropdown + handle or just a full-row drag? Thoughts on discoverability and accidental drags? @Derek @Sam @Tara
Derek: I'm leaning toward dropdown+handle. Full-row drag causes accidental moves when people try to select text or click the left badge. Dropdown clearly surfaces priority numbers and avoids mobile pain.
Sam: Agree. Dropdown lets us show explicit priority values and a small 'Move up / Move down' keyboard action. For drag handle, make it a visible button with aria-label="Reorder rule" and support modifier+arrow keys.
Tara: Also, preview signal: right now we highlight matched rules with a faint bg. With dense rows that's easy to miss. Suggest a persistent left-edge accent (4px) color-coded by match outcome: green=match, grey=skip, yellow=partial. Keeps the rows visually compact while being obvious.
Maya: Nice. For validation errors during preview runs, avoid toasts. Show a tiny inline badge on the rule: "Preview error" (click to expand details). Use aria-describedby to link to the details region so screen readers can jump.
Derek: Implementation note: cancel previous preview requests when user starts a new one; also debounce 200ms on rapid sample switching. The spinner right now sometimes stays after cancellation.
Sam: Copy tweak: Replace "Rule invalid" with "Will not match requests until a condition is added." Action-oriented and useful in-row. Also for empty-preview state: "Pick a sample request to preview which rules would match."
Tara: Contrast check: thin muted labels fail AA at 13px. Increase tone or bump size. UI-bot: can we add an automated contrast scan?
ui-bot: Contrast scan queued for the prototype. Found 2 low-contrast tokens: ids t-42, t-47. Recommend #52565A for label text.
Maya: Action items: Derek to spec dropdown + keyboard moves, Sam to write a11y notes for handle/aria-grabbed, Tara to adjust preview accent and add badge mock, Maya will update copy and swap toast -> inline badge. Review next Tue. :thumbsup:
